name: Yunzhong “Shawn” Xiao
mission: From fluent predictors to reliable collaborators.
intro: I work across the full stack of foundation model capability: pre-training to build representations, SFT and RL to shape behavior, synthetic data and evaluation to expose failure modes, and agents and tools to turn intelligence into reliable action.
currently: Conversational and multimodal foundation models at Apple

agenda.title: Train intelligence
agenda.text: Pre-training and continued pre-training for multimodal, speech, and conversational foundation models—supported by large-scale data and distributed systems.

agenda.title: Shape behavior
agenda.text: SFT, reward modeling, RL and RLVR, synthetic users, test-time scaling, and evaluations that make capability boundaries visible.

agenda.title: Build collaboration
agenda.text: Agents, tool capability memory, guardrails, and full-duplex interaction that turn model intelligence into dependable human–AI collaboration.

research.title: ToolMem: Enhancing Multimodal Agents with Learnable Tool Capability Memory
research.summary: Dynamic memory that helps agents learn the strengths and weaknesses of neural tools from test-time experience.

research.title: MMPerspective: Do MLLMs Understand Perspective?
research.summary: A ten-task benchmark for perspective perception, spatial reasoning, and robustness across 43 multimodal models.

research.title: Caption Anything in Video
research.summary: Training-free, fine-grained object-centric video captioning with spatially precise and temporally coherent descriptions.
